$comment: VisionQA check catalog (docs/VISIONQA.md section 4). appliesTo lists shot kinds. passWhen: below (probability must be under threshold), above, or choice. Thresholds come from thresholds.json after calibration (default 0.5).

checks.instructions: Ignore the HUD panels, buttons and the small minimap in the corner; judge only the large game view behind them. Is that view essentially blank: black, white, or a single flat color with no scene content?

Ignore the HUD panels, buttons and the small minimap in the corner; judge only the large game view behind them. Is a landscape with land (green or brown ground) and water clearly visible in that view?
Do any interface panels or text labels visibly overlap each other, clip, or run off the screen edge?
Are there obvious rendering glitches: bright magenta or pink missing-texture surfaces, stretched polygons, holes, or z-fighting stripes?
Which kind of screen is shown?

choices.description: A 3D perspective view of terrain, water or a small planet
A flat top-down map of the whole world
A menu or dialog fills most of the frame
An empty, black or broken frame

checks.instructions: How polished does this game frame look?

levels.label: acceptable
